### `Hornet_Create`

```c
entity Hornet_Create(entity creator, vector src, vector ang)
```

Constructs a hornet entity at `src` facing `ang`, belonging to `creator`.
Caller decides whether to then call Hornet_StartTrack or Hornet_StartDart.
